heading: ### The boundaries — what a service run is not

findings.quote: porcelain-clean is an opt-in precondition at open (SKILL.md:808-809)
findings.why: At C0 the cited span SKILL.md:808-809 is the service intro ('method outward as the service the fleet census offered' / '(`fleet-suite-census.md:249-291`)'), carrying no porcelain or tree-clean text, because the porcelain-clean-at-open clause the pointer was written for sits at SKILL.md:819-820 after the Standing-rules insertion moved the page by 11 lines.

findings.quote: a low kill rate is a report, not a service failure (SKILL.md:335)
findings.why: At C0 line 335 reads 'Both points sit on the 50-80/>80 boundary, so that boundary reading is the worked one; the bands below carry the admission decision.' and no longer supports the claim, because the '**Bands are a report convention, not a pass/fail gate.**' rule this pointer was written for now sits at SKILL.md:346-347 (same 11-line shift).
